statistical_suitability.bgnbd_verdict: UNSUITABLE for full population: Only 2.56% repeat customers (1474/57511). BG/NBD parameter MLE estimation degenerates on 90%+ one-time buyer datasets.
statistical_suitability.gamma_gamma_verdict: SUITABLE for repeat cohort: Pearson r = -0.008 (p=7.587e-01). Independence assumption holds.
statistical_suitability.recommended_strategy: Dual-Track Approach: Use Heuristic/Cohort-Based CLV for one-time buyers (96.9% of users) and Probabilistic BG/NBD + Gamma-Gamma strictly for the repeat-buyer subset.
